name: Full DDD Recommended Architecture (Preset)
description: For complex business domains: bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, anti-corruption layers. Suitable for scenarios with complex business rules, multi-context collaboration, and frequent state transitions.

layers.name: Presentation Layer
layers.responsibility: Controllers, pages, DTOs; does not carry business logic

layers.name: Application Layer
layers.responsibility: Use-case orchestration, command/query separation (CQRS optional), transactions, permissions

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.responsibility: Aggregate roots, entities, value objects, domain services, domain events, repository interfaces, business invariants
typical_files: AggregateRoot / Entity / ValueObject / DomainService / DomainEvent / RepositoryInterface

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.responsibility: Repository implementations, event bus, external system adaptation, anti-corruption layer (ACL)

code_requirements: Organize modules by bounded context; contexts collaborate through interfaces/events, never direct dependencies
Within an aggregate, access only through the aggregate root; the outside world may only reference the aggregate root
Domain events are used for cross-context/cross-module coordination; event subscribers are registered in the infrastructure layer
Business invariants must be enforced in the domain layer; never scatter them into the application layer or SQL
The anti-corruption layer isolates external systems so external models do not pollute the domain model
Align with bounded_context / aggregate_design / domain_events / api_contract
